fields.name: source_port
fields.description: Optional field; when meaningful, indicates the port of the sending process. If not used, a value of zero is inserted.

fields.name: destination_port
fields.description: Has a meaning within the context of a particular internet destination address.

fields.name: length
fields.description: The length in octets of this user datagram including this header and the data. The minimum value is eight.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: The 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of a pseudo header of information from the IP header, the UDP header, and the data. If the computed checksum is zero, it is transmitted as all ones.

parsing_context.name: pseudo_header
parsing_context.description: Conceptually prefixed to the UDP header for checksum computation; contains source address, destination address, zero (for reserved), protocol number, and UDP length.

parsing_context.name: ip_header
parsing_context.description: The internet header from which the pseudo-header is derived; provides source and destination internet addresses and the protocol field.
